sf.label: Stockfish 19
sf.method: Baseline: unrestricted MultiPV 3 at every position, 10M nodes, last completed iteration. Candidate comparisons (60M nodes) and deep checks (200M nodes) restrict the root moves and keep their own budgets.

observations.label: SF Lite
observations.caveat: depths scanned in same engine session with fresh game tokens; played move forced if absent from MultiPV 8. Scores depend on search history; these are candidate receipts, not benchmark.

notes.text: Black already has an advantage, with passed pawns on a3 and d3 backed by two bishops. The played 49.Rba1 gives way to 49...Ba4+ and a stronger attack. The local Stockfish Lite prefers 49.Rf2, keeping the rook active and offering more resistance; it does not change the reported game result.
Stockfish 19, 16 Nov 2026 (1 thread, 200M nodes, depth 44, deep check): Rf2 −3.91, played Rba1 −7.29 (mover POV). The catalog alternative is better by 3.38 pawns.
